title.zh: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions
title.en: Microsoft says its AI tool is better than doctors at diagnosing conditions

current_state.zh: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman announced a new AI diagnostic tool that the company claims can diagnose medical conditions up to four times more accurately than human doctors.
